description:
A crouched gray undead predator with grasping hands, ragged clothing, and a low, hungry stance. The original template records no carried items or wealth. Its action attacks with both arms reaching screen right while the upper body leans forward and the feet stay planted.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - ACTION:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: ACTION frame ONLY for OpenGold combat sprite MON8CHA.DAX:72/default/action, exported as a 128x128 PNG with genuine transparency.
Input Image 1: the checked-in MON8CHA.DAX:72/default/ready.png is the EDIT TARGET and exact Ghoul identity, body scale, costume, ground registration and pixel-art reference. Input Image 2: the user-approved bipedal pose guide is a facing and attack-direction reference ONLY; do not copy its character, clothing or weapons. No original game artwork is supplied.
Primary request: Turn this gray, skeletal, rag-clad Ghoul into a forceful TWO-ARM FORWARD REACH attack toward SCREEN RIGHT. Extend BOTH arms from their own shoulders through clearly connected elbows to separated clawed hands reaching right at roughly chest height, one slightly higher than the other. Both hands should grasp toward a target; no arm may remain folded at the waist, and neither may lift vertically in surrender. Lean the upper chest and head modestly to the right into the attack. Keep its hungry undead expression.
Invariants: Keep the same Ghoul face, gray bone-and-skin palette, ragged loincloth, front three-quarter screen-right view, Normal 5-foot body height, camera and apparent scale. The entire neck, chest, abdomen, waist, pelvis and legs remain anatomically continuous with no shear, gap, pasted-on half or doubled outline. Preserve the ready image's planted foot pixels at identical x and y coordinates and keep the pelvis and lower body registered. Animate only the upper torso/head lean and both reaching arms; do not translate, recenter, rotate, crop or resize the whole creature. Body and feet fit the saved 1x1 combat footprint. Reaching attack claws may cross the right dotted tile line if needed, but all pixels remain within the PNG canvas with transparent margin.
Equipment: No weapon, shield, magic item or other carried object exists in the saved gear; add none.
Output: ONE action frame only, not a sheet. Crisp readable fantasy pixel art matching the ready sprite at combat size, true alpha transparency. No opaque black box, glow, scenery, ground plane, text, border, motion blur, extra limbs, detached arms or copied game art.
